tray.updateFail: Update download failed, try again later
tray.updateCheckFail: Update check failed: cannot reach the update server ({reason})
tray.updateApplyFail: Update downloaded, but auto-apply failed: the install folder is not writable. Move the app to a writable folder (e.g. D:\SuzuranPet) and retry
tray.walkNeedSpine: Desktop walking requires the Spine model: Settings → Render Mode → "Spine Model"
tray.layerDesktop: Desktop level (can be covered by windows)
pet.termsToast: Please read and agree to the Terms & Privacy Policy first
set.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear all chat history?
set.confirmReset: Restore the default persona? Current edits will be lost.
set.title: 🦊 Sussurro · Settings
set.ollamaHint: Local Ollama needs no key (URL http://localhost:11434/v1); other providers use their OpenAI-compatible URL.
set.personaHint: Edit the text below to customize the character. {{userName}} is replaced with the name above, {{petName}} with the pet's name. Takes effect immediately.
set.sysVoiceFallback: System-voice fallback (what to speak when TTS engine is unavailable)
set.refAudio: Reference audio (clone voice, empty = server default)
set.speakJa: 🗣 Japanese voice mode: UI text stays Chinese, speech is translated to Japanese (with local JP fine-tuned voice)
set.gsvRestarting: ⏳ Restarting — first model load takes 1–2 minutes…
set.gsvOk: ✅ Restarted successfully, Japanese voice is ready
set.gsvTimeout: ❌ Restart failed: service not ready in time (see tts.log)
set.gsvSynthFail: ❌ Server started but test synthesis failed (see tts.log)
set.gsvDisabled: Japanese TTS service is disabled or misconfigured
set.gsvNoPath: Engine path not found (fresh install, not configured): set Python path & server script in voice settings
set.walkingOpt: 🚶 Desktop walking (strolls along the taskbar, sometimes hops onto a desktop window to sit; pauses while dragging; Spine mode only)
set.featDesktopIcons: 🧩 Desktop icon awareness (experimental): read-only access to desktop icon positions (local only, never uploaded) so she can stand/sit on desktop icons; requires "Desktop level" display mode
set.autoLaunch: 🖥️ Start with Windows (combine with "Start hidden" for silent tray launch)
set.focusMode: 🎯 Focus/Away mode (stays quiet while you're away/idle, greets you on return)
set.weatherOn: Enable weather (she occasionally reports; shown in info panel)
set.weatherProvider: Provider (open-meteo no key; openweathermap needs key; devs can register custom)
set.weatherKey: Provider API Key (leave empty for open-meteo)
set.onboard1: Enter a chat API Key (Settings→Chat API→Test→Save)
set.onboard2: Click the fox and send a message
set.onboard3: (Optional) Turn on voice so she can speak
set.spineHint: 💡 Easy skins: create one folder per skin under your user data assets/spine/user/ directory (e.g. myskin/) with .atlas+.skel(or .json)+.png, restart — they appear in tray 🧩 Character Skin menu; avoid # in file names
set.agentTitle: 🤝 Agent API (other AIs / scripts call her)
set.audHint: (Japanese GSV pipeline with live playback-parameter simulation; requires Japanese voice mode + GSV)
set.toneTitle: Voice enable (off = that emotion falls back to default voice/tone):
set.seatSink: Seat sink depth (how far the legs dangle into the taskbar)
set.standSink: Standing feet trim (neg=raise, pos=sink; tune per skin, 0=default)
set.agentWord: Custom invoke word (when set, /chat must start with it, e.g. "Sussurro")
set.netProxy: Network proxy (in-app updates/weather; empty = follow system. e.g. http=127.0.0.1:7897)
set.agentHint: Other agents/scripts can call: POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/chat with {"text":"Sussurro help me…"}; GET /health for status. Listens on localhost only, not exposed to LAN.
set.taskHint: Task mode (/zcode prefix controls the PC) is off by default: open config.json, set zcodeEnabled to true and configure zcodeCli path (ZCode must be installed).
set.logdiagHint: Shows recent runtime log (tts.log): red = error (needs attention), yellow = warning (self-healed). Export is auto-sanitized (keys, URL params, username in paths, window titles, precise coordinates, PIDs, nicknames) and safe to share.
set.dirtyPartial: ⚠ Some sections failed to save, check their hints
set.fixedOnlyHint: 🔋 Fixed-line offline mode: local voice engines shut down to free VRAM; cached fixed lines keep playing, uncached ones are not synthesized on the fly (falls back to system voice)
set.fixedPoolHint: Generates for the current voice profile only; cached audio is kept indefinitely (space is reclaimed LRU-style when over budget). Cloud voices may incur API costs. System voice needs no preload.
set.fixedNeedPool: Please select at least one line pool
set.fixedStarting: Generating line by line with the current voice; finished items are kept…
set.fixedRetryErrors: Retry finished, but some items still failed
set.fixedCancelRequested: Pause requested; stops after the current audio finishes.
set.fixedClearConfirm: Clears the fixed-line audio cache of the current voice profile only; chat history and memory are kept. Continue?
set.fixedClearOldConfirm: Cleans old-version line caches left by previous voices/languages; the current profile cache is kept. Continue?
set.fixedOnlyStopping: Stopping voice engines and freeing VRAM…
set.fixedOnlyOn: Offline mode on: only cached fixed lines are spoken
set.fixedOnlyOff: Offline mode off: engines are back to work
set.renameCacheWarn: User name changed: fixed-line voices are cached per name, so affected lines will be regenerated (time and API cost depend on the voice profile). Save anyway?
set.upToDate: You are on the latest version ✅
set.updateReadyRestart: Update ready — the app will restart to finish updating ✅
set.updateDeclined: Update skipped (you can check again anytime)
set.updateAutoCheckHint: Checks for new versions silently every 24 hours
tray.updateRestarting: Update ready — restarting to finish updating…

notice.taskModeDisabled: Task mode is disabled (enable zcodeEnabled in config.json)
notice.fallbackRig: 2.5D assets unavailable, fell back to GIF

notice.softwareRenderOn: Software rendering enabled — takes effect after restart
notice.hardwareRenderOn: Switched to hardware rendering — takes effect after restart
notice.jaTranslateFail: ⚠️ Japanese translation failed; speaking with the Chinese voice for now (check the chat API quota or key)
notice.memoryFileReset: ⚠️ Memory file was abnormal (possibly modified externally) and has been reset
notice.firstRunApiSetup: First run: set your API key and nickname in Settings 💕
